purpose: Diagnose the apparent seqproc single-thread slowdown in the qualitatively aligned 10x v2 timing campaign

conclusion.root_cause: The August 10 campaign froze seqproc 46d66d6 and antisequence 45f0bdb, while the earlier optimized campaign used their direct descendants edbf9ef and f3b0f1e. The optimized commits remained on pe-single-thread-optimizations side branches and had not been fast-forwarded into preprint-fixes-revisions.
conclusion.campaign_disposition: The partially completed August 10 campaign is diagnostic only and must not be combined with the replacement campaign.

profile_interpretation.optimized_effect: The optimized compiler emits a terminal same-lane ProjectOp and fuses match-result retention into MatchAnyOp. This removes the generic label/concatenation traversal, avoids temporary concatenation and copy-back work, and greatly reduces unpredictable branching.
profile_interpretation.thread_count_interaction: At one thread, all redundant graph and copy work is serialized. At 16 threads it is distributed across workers and largely hidden by the pipeline/I/O floor, explaining why the rollback changed full-data t16 time only from 41.97-42.22 s to 43.22 s.

full_data_confirmation.interpretation: The restored seqproc run is about twice as fast as the rolled-back seqproc build and about 30% faster than the observed Splitcode single-thread timing. This confirmation is an implementation gate, not a publication replicate.

correctness_and_tests.prior_slice_validation: Baseline and optimized outputs were byte-identical for 10x v2, paired-end SPLiT-seq, sci-RNA-seq3, and forward long-read SPLiT-seq; see terminal_projection_and_match_fusion_2026-08-07.json.

remediation.note: The replacement manifest is frozen only after this diagnostic artifact is committed, avoiding a cyclic claim in which the committed artifact changes the analysis revision recorded by the manifest.

raw_diagnostics.contents: Exact baseline/restored binaries, alternating timing TSVs, full-run GNU time output, five-repetition perf stat reports, and perf record data for both revisions.
